properties.name: Four colour history rung on 0.90.0 (design 7d851f5be7cca068): PASS on structure. Kempe's one broken step falls alone, the five colour theorem stands on what survived, and three modern routes each survive the loss of another's premise. But a status that held for a period is never read back, a computer or kernel proof can only read "conditional on trust", an unverified objection defeats a step outright, and the independence check ignores shared taken-as-given data.
properties.statement:
Anthony, 2026-10-22: "Go with your recommendations, all three in that order". Observer: the coordinating session. Reference: scratchpad fc-trial/OBSERVER.md. The designer was given a checked source packet with FULL sha256 values (S1 Gonthier, Notices 2008; S2 the RSST page; S3 and S4 Wikipedia) and was allowed recall, marked as recalled. Result: 42 statements, 25 steps, 5 checks, 7 dated status records and 6 owner questions (batch fc-round-1). The observer reran propagate_from on Kempe's degree-5 step and reasoning_report on the five colour theorem.

PASS:
(1) Kempe's degree-5 step is the ONE broken step. Its what-if reaches only Kempe's own line: the degree-5 lemma, the falsum and the reductio. The degree ≤3 lemma reads shown, the degree-4 lemma conditional on Jordan, and the Kempe-chain lemma holds.
(2) The 5CT reads conditional only on the unverified Euler and Jordan citations. Its hypothesis is discharged. It is built from what survived of Kempe.
(3) Tait's equivalence survives the refutation of Tait's proof.
(4) Three routes to the 4CT. Dropping Birkhoff 1913 takes Appel–Haken and RSST. Dropping trust in the Coq kernel, or dropping the bridge, takes only the Coq route; the Coq theorems stand when the bridge goes.
(5) Both source disagreements are recorded as evidence pairs, neither read refuted. The computer-proof reception moves no status, and the question "does a computer case analysis count?" waits proposed.
(6) Independence check: RSST against Appel–Haken correctly reads NOT independent (shared Birkhoff, Euler, the degree lemma and the chain lemma).

OBSERVER CORRECTION: the reference said dropping Birkhoff takes ALL three routes. The designer modelled Birkhoff as proved inside the Coq development, which fits S1 ("formalize the entire proof"). The reference overstated the shared premise.

FINDINGS FOR REFLOW2 (designer-reported; the falsum and hypothesis readings were confirmed in the observer's own reads):
(a) NO STATUS OVER A PERIOD. "Accepted 1879–1890, open 1890–1976" lives only in dated TemporalFacts, which reasoning_report, get_node and propagate_from never read. This sits beside the NS map's missing "claimed" reading.
(b) A MACHINE-CHECKED PROOF CAN ONLY READ "CONDITIONAL ON TRUST". Trust in the kernel or the programs is an assumption, so the 4CT reads conditional on all three routes. Program results and a kernel check are both `method: analysis, computed: true`, with nothing to tell them apart.
(c) AN UNVERIFIED OBJECTION DEFEATS A STEP OUTRIGHT. A taken_as_given objection with no pinned source defeated Kempe's step at once, where the skill says it should contest. Related: req:a-conclusion-whose-every-route-is-contested-reads-contested (PR A1).
(d) ANSWERING AN OBJECTION MARKS IT FALSE. A reply makes the objection read refuted. There is no "right against the 1976 version, since repaired", and no versioned step.
(e) THE INDEPENDENCE CHECK IGNORES SHARED TAKEN-AS-GIVEN DATA. Coq against RSST read "share no step" though both rest on con:rsst-633-configurations. Excepting a lemma does not except the citations beneath it. This partly reproduces the NS map's finding (b).
(f) THE BRIDGE READS IN THE WORDS OF A STATISTICAL TEST: "supported at α … statistical test(s)", and rests_on_tests, for an author's report. There is no bridge kind yet (PR A1 builds it).
(g) Known, again:
- software gaps on a proof design (no_deploy_operate, build_without_governance, encoding_undecided);
- a discharged hypothesis reads "not delivered, status proposed";
- unlinked_intent on assumed premises;
- propagate_from lists upstream premises as impacted;
- a falsum losing support reads "refuted";
- a falsum reads proof_status "unproven" beside reads "false".
All are RCA faults or falsum-walk items in PR A1.
(h) The hub's schemas lag the server: add_requirement lists 7 statement kinds, and add_inference lacks cases, rule_node and establishes. The view_note tells you to pass `member` where no schema declares it.

ADDED 2026-10-23, when applying the owner's answers ("Go with your recommendations on all of them"):
(i) "TAKE IT AS GIVEN" CANNOT BE SAID FOR A CITED THEOREM. Euler's formula, the Jordan curve theorem, Birkhoff 1913 and Tait's equivalence already carried taken_as_given: true, but reasoning_report still reads them "unverified citation(s) … no pinned source documents them", so every route stays "conditional". The owner's word changed no reading.
(ii) The two Coq steps now record confirmed_how "checker" (the Coq kernel), on his word.
